transcript: Speaker A (AI): Date par English bolne se dar lagta hai? [Scared of speaking English on a date?] Speaker B: Haan, waiter ke English bolne par meri bolti band ho gayi. [Yes, I froze when the waiter spoke English.] Speaker A: SpeakEasy App try karo, mere saath roz natural English bolo. [Try SpeakEasy App, speak natural English with me daily.] Speaker B: Par meri English weak hai. [But my English is weak.] Speaker A: Main aaraam se samjhaungi. [I will explain easily.] Speaker B: Lambi classes ka time nahi hai. [No time for long classes.] Speaker A: Sirf 15 mins practice, trial ₹1 mein. [Just 15 mins practice, trial for ’1.] Speaker B: Perfect, agli date par style se order karungi. [Perfect, I will order in style next time.] Speaker A: Speakeasy ke saath English shuru karo. [Start English with Speakeasy.] Speaker B: Aaj hi install karti hoon. [Installing today.] Speaker C: Speakeasy app download karein aur English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy and start speaking English.]
on_screen_text: Date Par English Bolne Se Dar Lagta Hai? SpeakEasy App. Trial Bhi Sirf ’1 Mein. Speakeasy AI - Speak English Easily. Install Now.
summary: An ad targeting the fear of speaking English on dates. An AI avatar recommends the Speakeasy app to a user, highlighting 15-minute daily practice and a ’1 trial. The CTA encourages downloading the app.
